faqs.q: How much does Asian Mental Health Collective cost?
faqs.a: Free to search; therapists set their own fees. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Asian Mental Health Collective before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Asian Mental Health Collective replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: Asian Mental Health Collective connects you with licensed professionals, so it can be a route into real care. It isn't an emergency service: if you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.

faqs.a: Asian Mental Health Collective is available on the web.
